Name: (FS) Customizable Colors for Vanilla
Author: Saah
Description:
[size=5]Description[/size]
Nothing too fancy - this is a conversion of vanilla fashion items to Fashion Sense so you'll be able to configure its colors.

[size=5]Requirements[/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ 4.0.0+
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ 6.2.1+ (keep in mind you have to buy the Hand Mirror from Pierre and use it to see FS items)
[/list]
[size=5]Available Items[/size]
About bloating: It's 100% safe to delete items from your copy of the mod. If you don't want to see female pants, you can delete all their folders and only leave male folders in Pants.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2373]List of Items[/url]
[list]
[*]All [b]pants/skirts[/b] (both male and female versions available). Huge thank you to [url=https://github.com/elizabethcd/SkirtConverter]Skirt Converter[/url]!
[*]All [b]hats [/b]except Bridal Veil (Fashion Sense can't change semitransparent colors)
[*]For [b]accessories[/b], install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10317]FS - Vanilla Accessories[/url] instead, but we do have a few hats that were converted to accessories.
[*][b]Hairstyles [/b]are already configurable in vanilla, so they'll never be added to this mod.
[*][b]Shirts[/b] are converted on request, so we don't have many.
[/list]When requesting a shirt, please check the wiki and tell me either its name or the materials required to craft it. That way I'll know which shirt you're walking about! Requests are currently [b][color=#1e84cc]open[/color][/b].
[size=5]Before You Use a Shirt![/size][size=4]
[/size]Sleeves in Fashion Sense are a different piece of clothing. To add sleeves to your shirt, select the icon beneath pants, make sure you're on "Sleeves", and search for my Simple Sleeves. They're just Fashion Sense's template sleeves, I didn't do anything. Now go back to your shirt , select the layer (if any) you want to match the sleeves, and press the little 📄 file icon beneath the dresser icon, at the part that's to the right of the main rectangle. That's the Copy Color button! Copy the layer's color, go back to the Simple Sleeve, and paste clicking on the square button beneath the Copy button. Now your sleeves match your shirt! (I also highly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15431]SH's Gloves and Sleeves Pack[/url]﻿ if you're looking for more sleeve customization)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/D7YYFIO.png[/img]

[size=5]Known Issues and Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]No known incompatibilities
[*]There's no check whether you've unlocked the item in-game to add it to the Fashion Sense pack
[*]Some hats might have strange, opaque shadows. If you see any, please let me know so I can fix it!
[/list]
[size=5]Permissions[/size]
Go wild! You're allowed to do anything at all.
